definitions.explanation: The academic field studying drugs, medicines, and their effects on the body. Includes the development, preparation, and proper use of medications.

examples.japanese: {薬学|やくがく}を{学|まな}んでいる。
{薬学部|やくがくぶ}は{六年制|ろくねんせい}になった。
examples.english: The pharmacy department has become a six-year program.

examples.japanese: {薬学|やくがく}の{知識|ちしき}を{活|い}かして{製薬会社|せいやくがいしゃ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a pharmaceutical company, making use of my pharmacy knowledge.

notes: Common collocations: {薬学部|やくがくぶ} (pharmacy department/faculty), {薬学|やくがく}{研究|けんきゅう} (pharmaceutical research), {薬学|やくがく}の{博士号|はくしごう} (doctorate in pharmacy). In Japan, {薬学部|やくがくぶ} programs were extended from four to six years in 2006. Graduates can take the {薬剤師|やくざいし} (pharmacist) licensing exam. Part of the {〜学|がく} (study of ~) word family, like {医学|いがく} (medicine) and {歯学|しがく} (dentistry).
